title: 中国AI三桶水：香港只有一桶，美银Winnie说透了
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: If I look more at my own market in China, do I focus on issues then? Stick to A, or do you think there's more of that diversification of AI in Hong Kong?
segments.zh: 如果更关注中国内地市场，是聚焦问题，还是坚持内地市场，或者认为香港市场在AI方面更多元？

segments.en: So, Asia for the AI side, previously we said there are three buckets of AI, right?
segments.zh: 亚洲在AI方面，之前我们说过有三类，对吧？

segments.en: Hong Kong is mainly the downstream application, whether it's the internet companies or the LLMs or the EVs of the world.
segments.zh: 香港市场主要是下游应用，无论是互联网公司、大语言模型还是电动汽车。

segments.en: Asia has two more buckets. One are the infrastructure exporters, right, optical transceivers, the PCBs, many of like the liquid cooling, the upstream stuff.
segments.zh: 亚洲还有两类。一类是基础设施出口商，比如光模块、PCB、液冷等上游产品。

segments.en: But there's also the localization names like the equipment, the memories, the fungries, right?
segments.zh: 但也有本地化标的，比如设备、存储、代工厂等。

segments.en: So, I do think China overall offers more diversification.
segments.zh: 所以我认为中国整体提供更多元化的选择。

segments.en: Even though we are structurally more cautious on the exporters, I think there should be a point where some of the domestic localization names
segments.zh: 尽管我们对出口商结构性更谨慎，但我认为某些国内本地化标的可能到了某个时点

segments.en: become interesting enough, right? Previously, our biggest concern is the valuation, right?
segments.zh: 会变得足够有吸引力，对吧？之前我们最大的担忧是估值，对吧？

segments.en: Because some of them were trading at like 100 times per year.
segments.zh: 因为其中一些标的的市盈率曾高达100倍。

segments.en: Now, after the multi-party rating, I think people are still questioning some of the fundamental drivers, for example, US is currently proposing this match act,
segments.zh: 现在，经过多方评级后，我认为人们仍在质疑一些基本面驱动因素，例如美国目前提出的MATCH法案，

segments.en: which is essentially requiring the allies, like, you know, the Dutches, the Japanese equipment suppliers to cut off the servicing of existing installed equipment in China,
segments.zh: 这实质上要求盟友，比如荷兰、日本设备供应商，切断对中国现有已安装设备的维护服务，

segments.en: and of course, to stop the supplying of advanced chips.
segments.zh: 当然，还要停止供应先进芯片。

segments.en: And if that happens, it could have an active impact on China's domestic localization progress in terms of the access to equipment capacity yield, right?
segments.zh: 如果发生这种情况，可能会对中国国内在设备产能和良率获取方面的本地化进展产生实际影响，对吧？

segments.en: So, we still need to figure out how does that evolves, right?
segments.zh: 所以，我们仍需观察事态如何演变，对吧？

segments.en: You know, the X will be up for voting toward the end of the year, November, December.
segments.zh: 你知道，X 将在年底左右，11月、12月进行投票。

segments.en: So, there are still things we are watching, but I think the localization remains to be a good structural story in China, and there should be a point that valuation becomes cheap enough
segments.zh: 所以，我们仍在关注一些事情，但我认为本地化在中国仍是一个良好的结构性故事，并且应该有一个估值变得足够便宜的点，

segments.en: that people should be bottom fish. Whereas Hong Kong, in the short term, might actually be defensive in the sense that it's under owned, it's value, it's cheap,
segments.zh: 届时人们应该抄底。而香港，短期内可能实际上具有防御性，因为它被低配、属于价值型、便宜，

segments.en: and the Hong Kong market financial is still a big part of the HSI index, right?
segments.zh: 而且香港市场的金融业仍是恒生指数的重要组成部分，对吧？

segments.en: And that could give you some support. And some of the large cap, even the consumer's names, is also having some yield and go.
segments.zh: 这可以给你一些支撑。一些大盘股，甚至消费类股，也有一定的收益率和增长。

segments.en: So, Hong Kong might be a short term hiding places, especially after the reason sale of the big technical internet names,
segments.zh: 所以，香港可能是一个短期的避风港，尤其是在大型科技互联网股遭遇抛售之后，

segments.en: but I think next year, Asia localization could be the bottom fishing area.
segments.zh: 但我认为明年亚洲本地化可能成为低位布局区域。
